description: Use this when someone looks for a place in Japan to have a car service done, such as a vehicle inspection (shaken), a self-service or hand car wash, a coating, a wheel alignment, or fitting coilovers, near a city or a point. Do not use it for car history or parts; use the other skills. Returns only shops confirmed to offer the service, nearest first, within radius_km of the origin: {service: {code, name, conditions}, origin, radius_km, require, total, shops, next_offset}. Each shop has name, shop_type, address, distance_km, availability (available, or conditional when it depends on the car), price_min, price_max, price_note, confirmed (the conditions checked for this shop: a yes_no condition with available true or false, a number condition such as an inspection fee with value and unit), the url of its public page, where the booking link and sources are, and area_url, the public page of its city or ward that lists the nearby shops side by side to compare. For vehicle_inspection, each shop also has inspection_totals, one row per car weight class (weight, shop_fee_yen, legal_fees_yen, total_yen): legal_fees_yen is the weight tax, compulsory insurance and stamp fee of a regular two-year inspection, for a car not old enough for the older-car weight tax and without eco-car tax relief. Quote total_yen as the price, never an inspection fee in confirmed alone; parts and extra repairs are not included. A condition missing from confirmed is not researched yet, never absent. service.conditions lists each condition with its type; pass yes_no codes in require to keep only shops confirmed to meet them. The order is distance only. Empty shops means nothing matched among the shops confirmed so far, not that no such shop exists; widen radius_km.

inputSchema.description: Pass area, or both latitude and longitude.

area.description: A Japanese city, ward, town or village in Japanese, such as 藤沢, 藤沢市 or 横浜市港北区. Add the prefecture (東京都府中市) when a name exists in several prefectures.

latitude.description: Origin latitude, when no area is given.

longitude.description: Origin longitude, when no area is given.

offset.description: Where to start in the list; pass next_offset from the previous response. Omit to start from the beginning.

radius_km.description: Distance from the origin, in km.

require.description: yes_no condition codes from service.conditions of a previous response; only shops confirmed to meet all of them are returned.

service_code.description: The service: vehicle_inspection (shaken, 車検), self_car_wash (セルフ洗車), hand_car_wash (手洗い洗車), automatic_car_wash (機械洗車), coating (コーティング), wheel_alignment_4 (4輪アライメント), camber_adjustment, toe_adjustment, tire_replacement (タイヤ交換), suspension_install (車高調・サスペンション取付).
